ContentRef.description:
Where a large or sensitive body lives: `event_content.hash` (xxh3-128
hex) and its length. Retention may delete the body; the ref stays.

size.description: The whole body's length, stored or not.

truncated.description: Only the first part was stored (bodies are capped).

TurnSource.description:
What opened a turn (`agent_turn.source`), as its harness read the
prompt hook. Only `person` is a person's words; the others are what the
harness delivered to the agent on its own.

oneOf.description:
A job the agent started in the background reported back (Claude
Code's task notification: a background shell or subagent finished).
A subagent handed its report back to its session.
The harness opened a turn and said nothing of why.

description:
`agent.prompt.submitted@3`: a prompt reached the agent — a person's,
a background job's report, a subagent's hand-back, another session's
message (`source`). Every delivery logs one; one with no turn open also
opens a turn (`reprompt` says it landed inside an open one).

job.description:
On a background job's report or a subagent's hand-back: the
harness's id for the job (the subagent's id).

prompt.description: The text the harness delivered, stored in `event_content`.

sender.description:
On another session's message: the sender's own name for its
session (its socket when it has no name).

source.description: Who it came from. Rows logged before sources were read `unknown`.

turn.description: The turn it opened, or the one it was delivered into (`trn12`).

title: AgentPromptSubmittedV3
